::: {.column width="45%"}

I use computer science to advance mathematics, especially university mathematics education. I studied both subjects at the [University of Scranton](http://www.scranton.edu) and at [Indiana University](https://www.iub.edu), earning a Ph.D. in mathematical logic in 2004.

I then joined the faculty of [Bentley University](https://www.bentley.edu) and have worked in logic, group theory visualization, computer graphics, data science, educational software, and social network analysis.

This is my professional website, but I also have [a research profile on Bentley's website](https://faculty.bentley.edu/profile/ncarter).

:::
